concept.title: Questions instead of guesses
concept.shortdesc: Where the sources conflict, or don't say, a draft carries a question in a draft-comment element. DITA processors don't render draft comments by default, and the merge gate fails while any is open, so a question can't ship by accident.

conbody.p: Each question names who should answer it: the engineer for values, the writer for wording and structure. The TPU7x set has two real conflicts:

ul.li: Sibling units (KI-1). The v6e topic gives HBM capacity in GB; the v5p topic gives it in GiB. The TPU7x facts use GiB. The writer confirms the unit and corrects the sibling that is wrong.

Two values for one quantity (KI-2). The TPU7x specification table gives HBM bandwidth as 7380 GBps, which is 7.38 TB/s. The memory section says approximately 7.37 TB/s. The engineer says which is right.

conbody.p: If the model doesn't ask about a conflict, adds the question itself. A topic that is new in the generation, with no sibling, is a stub: a title, a short description, an outline of sections and, in each section, the facts it should cover.
To answer a question, edit the topic and delete the draft-comment, or set its disposition attribute to closed.
